description: This file defines the SetupScriptRunner class responsible for executing worktree setup scripts within a Visual Studio Code extension environment. It manages script execution, terminal creation, environment variable setup, and logging.

classes.name: SetupScriptRunner
classes.description: Class responsible for running setup scripts in a VS Code environment, managing terminal execution, environment variables, and logging.

methods.name: runIfConfigured
methods.description: Checks if a setup script exists and executes it if available, returning whether the script was run.

methods.name: executeInTerminal
methods.description: Creates a terminal in VS Code and runs the setup script with appropriate environment variables.

methods.name: buildCommand
methods.description: Constructs the shell command to execute the setup script, handling platform-specific differences.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages to the output channel.
